evaluation.interpretation: aggregate metrics compare a fitted conditional program dictionary with zero, global-only, and equal-membership baselines; individual program evidence is limited to its held-marker removal interval
evaluation.protocol: eight deterministic held-patient folds with all source statistics and loadings refit; five deterministic held-marker folds within each held patient
evaluation.validation_scope: same-cohort held-marker reconstruction; not external validation

profile.source_attribution: Kim et al., Integrated proteogenomic characterization of glioblastoma evolution; Neftel et al. Table S2, DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2019.06.024, source digest sha256:208e73ab3d22c494caf85c867d69dc6be38df3fc62ab1f043d7fcc5441066277.
source_terms: Neftel Table S2 terms/license state is not asserted by this derived catalog.
profile.source_transformation_notice: Transformed by GLIO-PROTEOGEN into a de-identified coefficient artifact. Technical channels were median-collapsed; strict paired protein changes were robustly fit; no raw patient matrices, sample UUIDs, or patient identifiers are redistributed. This adaptation is not endorsed by the source authors. Neftel markers were normalized through the pinned HGNC catalog and projected onto the frozen KNCC protein axis.

limitations: Research-use-only same-cohort protein-transition concordance; not clinical evidence.
The fitted evaluation is internal reconstruction and is not external validation.
Neftel membership does not establish subtype, cell fraction, activation, flux, or causality.
The fitted conditional dictionary modestly outperforms the global-only baseline but underperforms the prespecified equal-membership baseline.
No individual fitted program effect is supported by the locked source evaluation.
Cohort leave-program-out intervals cross zero for every individual program.
Caller held-marker reconstruction is a request-specific stability check, not validation.
One-sided censor limits are retained as bounds; two censored limits are uninformative.
Missing and unsupported observations are excluded and never become negative evidence.
Overlapping markers are degree-corrected and exposed through structural ablations.
Bootstrap intervals describe measurement and fitted-source sensitivity, not probability.
Missingness, preprocessing, sampling, and cohort transport remain limitations.
Outputs are not recurrence prediction, patient evolution, or treatment evidence.
